title: MEOWCHA: a small cat pilots a big robot. A jam game built with Claude Code
author: Kooky-Audience-2291
selftext:
A cat and a robot escape a lab, a factory and a tower to switch off a giant vacuum. While the cat is out of the hatch, the robot stands still, so every level asks: who goes where?

Claude Code wrote the code, built the levels and drew the pixel art in code; some props and the music were generated. Two things I learned: the AI can't hear, so it measured every sound's loudness instead, and scripted playtests proved the levels solvable, but only playing them myself showed what felt dull.

Made in a week for the Jamference AI Game Jam (movement input only). Free in the browser: [https://funkyape.itch.io/meowcha](https://funkyape.itch.io/meowcha)
